title: Omani Arabic
description: Variety of Peninsular Arabic spoken in Oman
extract: Omani Arabic is a variety of Arabic spoken in the Al Hajar Mountains of Oman and the UAE and in a few neighboring coastal regions. It is the easternmost traditional Arabic dialect. It was formerly spoken by colonists in Kenya and Tanzania, but these days, it mainly remains spoken on the island of Zanzibar.
